summary: Enhance your data skills with our Data Preparation and Cleaning Training Course. Learn essential techniques to clean and prepare data for analysis effectively.
lede: Data preparation involves profiling records, resolving inconsistencies, and checking quality before analysis or reporting. For data analysts, BI and reporting professionals, the course develops practical workflows for identifying missing values and duplicates, standardizing fields, applying validation rules, and transforming data in Excel and SQL, with cleaning logs to document decisions and support review.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who clean, validate, transform, and reconcile data before reporting or analysis. It suits people who need practical methods they can apply immediately in daily data work.
prerequisites: Participants should have basic spreadsheet literacy and a working understanding of tabular data. No programming background is required, although familiarity with Excel formulas and simple SQL queries will help you progress faster. A laptop is recommended for hands-on exercises, and participants should be ready to work with sample datasets, cleaning templates, and validation checklists.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
